name: text-humanizer
description: Atypical Consulting skills for writing that reads like a person wrote it.

plugins.name: text-humanizer
plugins.description: Rewrites LLM-generated text (FR/EN) so it reads human: removes AI tics, applies format best practices (LinkedIn, email, YouTube script, blog, description), fact-checks dated claims and measures before/after. Two skills, same behaviour: text-humanizer for requests written in English, humaniser-texte for requests written in French.
